verdicts.title: Danse sauvage
verdicts.note: Wrong source and wrong credit: 'Danse sauvage' is NOT from Harnasie and has no opus number. Polish Wikipedia's list of works has it as a miniature for violin and piano, 1920, a joint composition of Szymanowski and Kochanski, published by C. Fischer, New York, 1925; English Wikipedia lists it (as 'Dance sauvage') as co-composed with Kochanski, 1921-22. The Harnasie piece is a different transcription ('Taniec z Harnasiow', UE 1931) - see gaps. The Carl Fischer edition is known only from the Polish list; I could not see a publisher page. English Wikipedia's spelling 'Dance sauvage' looks like a typo.

verdicts.title: Zarzyjze kuniu (Kurpian Song), Op. 58 No. 9 (arr. Kochański)
verdicts.note: The piece is the violin and piano transcription (by Szymanowski and Kochanski, 1931) of No. 9 of the 12 Kurpian Songs, Op. 58, 'Zarzyjze kuniu' (Polish Wikipedia list: published UE 1932; English list gives 1931). 'Kurpian Song' on its own is not a title in the sources I could open, so I put the incipit first. Spelling varies between sources (Polish list 'Zarzyjze kuniu'; English list 'Zarżyjze kuniu' in the song list and 'Zarżyjzę kuniu' in the violin row) - check the UE title page for the exact spelling. Publisher not confirmed on a publisher site.

gaps.title: Taniec z Harnasiów (Dance from Harnasie), Op. 55 (arr. Kochański)
gaps.scoring: violin and piano (transcription of a dance from the ballet Harnasie by Szymanowski and Kochanski)
gaps.edition: Universal Edition, 1931 (per Polish Wikipedia list of works)
gaps.note: Second source: English Wikipedia list (1931, violin and piano, transcribed by the composer and Kochanski from Harnasie, Op. 55). Publisher not confirmed on a publisher site. This is the Harnasie piece the queued N2 was confused with. Duration and level are my estimates.

gaps.title: L'aube
gaps.scoring: violin and piano (joint work of Szymanowski and Kochanski)
gaps.edition: Universal Edition, 1925 (per Polish Wikipedia list of works)
gaps.note: LOWER CONFIDENCE: English Wikipedia list also has 'L'aube' (1925), violin and piano, co-composed with Kochanski; edition not confirmed on a publisher site, duration and level are estimates. Not reported: 'Berceuse' (1921-22, co-composed with Kochanski), listed only on the English Wikipedia list with no edition located; and a violin and piano arrangement of the Prelude in B minor, Op. 1 by Grazyna Bacewicz, mentioned on the Polish list without publication details.
